items.title: Americans are on a 'treadmill of high inflation' and more rate hikes are likely, Fed's Daly says
items.summary: San Francisco Federal Reserve President Mary Daly said Friday she expects the central bank will need to raise interest rates further, but joined her fellow policymakers in saying the pace and timing remain uncertain.

items.title: The AI ‘credit card’ is getting costlier as CoreWeave bond yield tops 16%
items.summary: Debt markets are sending a message to AI data center builders: we're hiking the interest rate on your credit card and may put some new curbs on your credit limit.

items.title: Nasdaq drops into correction territory — here’s what typically happens next
items.summary: The Nasdaq Composite plunged into correction territory on Thursday. History shows more selling can follow in the near term, but a recovery eventually takes hold three months later.

items.title: A disturbing employment trend is hiding beneath the latest strong job numbers
items.summary: Americans who lose their jobs these days are facing a harsh new problem: It's getting harder to find another one quickly.

items.title: U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected; unemployment rate slips to 4.1%
items.summary: The U.S. economy added jobs at a much stronger-than-expected pace in October, while the unemployment rate moved lower as the labor market showed surprising strength.
